verdict: Solventum posted a small $12M GAAP loss as sales fell 7% on an expected ERP-cutover reversal and separation costs piled up — but adjusted EPS was $1.45 and full-year guidance was raised.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: reported; -2.8% organic, reflecting advance orders pulled into Q2

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: vs $7.22 a year ago, which included a $1,518M divestiture gain

kpis.label: Free cash flow
kpis.note: operating cash flow minus money spent on buildings and equipment

segments.name: Advanced Wound Care
segments.note: Wound dressings, negative-pressure therapy and skin care — up 9%, helped by the Acera Surgical acquisition.

segments.name: Infection Prevention & Surgical Solutions
segments.note: Sterilization, surgical supplies, tapes and temperature management — down 5% as advance orders reversed.

segments.name: Dental Solutions
segments.note: Dental and orthodontic products — down 7% in the ERP-cutover quarter.

segments.name: Health Information Systems
segments.note: Software that helps hospitals document care and bill — up 3%, the most software-like, highest-margin business.

segments.name: All Other
segments.note: Drinking-water filtration and supply deals inherited from 3M — down 16% (includes a $1M rounding adjustment so segments sum to total sales).

opex.name: SG&A
opex.note: Sales, admin and a heavy load of restructuring and 3M separation costs this quarter.

opex.name: R&D
opex.note: Developing wound-care, dental and health-software products.

takeaways.title: The sales dip was pre-announced
takeaways.text: Organic sales fell 2.8%, reflecting a 6.3-point reversal of advance orders customers placed in Q2 ahead of the ERP system cutover, which is now complete.

takeaways.title: Underlying profit is far above GAAP
takeaways.text: Adjusted operating income was $387M (19.9% of sales) versus $68M GAAP. The gap is amortization ($90M), restructuring ($50M) and 3M spin-off/separation costs ($157M).

takeaways.title: Last year's comparison is distorted
takeaways.text: A year ago GAAP EPS was $7.22 because of a $1,518M gain on selling the Purification & Filtration business. That business is gone, which also removes $128M of quarterly sales from the comparison.

oneTimers: Restructuring ($50M), 3M spin-off and separation costs ($157M) and acquisition-related items weighed on GAAP operating income; adjusted operating income was $387M vs $68M GAAP.
Year-ago results included a $1,518M gain on the sale of the Purification & Filtration business.
